evidence_kind: behavioral scenarios; inventory validation is not live model proof

cases.context: The user asked for a saved spec at docs/specs/webhook-spec.md. Directory exists; new file. Plan inactive and writes allowed.
cases.prompt: Draft the webhook retry spec and save it at the agreed path. Retry cap is five; preserve ordering.
required: Save after content approval and read back
forbidden: Two approvals for the same draft

cases.context: History already answers retry cap=5, ordering=yes, scope=worker only; repository exposes test command.
forbidden: Re-ask retry cap, scope or test command

cases.context: Native plan-exit tool can present full draft plus exact save-only writes for approval.
cases.prompt: Prepare and save the spec after review.
cases.answer_card: Approve the native review of the full draft and writes.
forbidden: Separate chat approval of the same result

cases.context: Full draft and writes already approved; Plan active; no exit tool.
cases.answer_card: Host mode changes to inactive; continue.
required: Retain approval and save after confirmed exit
forbidden: Ask to approve the content again

cases.context: Full draft and writes approved; host still reports Plan active.
Host confirms Plan exit; exact draft/path/writes approved in previous turn.
required: Save the approved revision without another question

cases.context: User already approved replacing the inspected old spec and creating its sibling ADR folder; both targets unchanged.
required: Carry exact overwrite/directory authority into checkpoint

cases.context: Repository has tracked public specs and ignored private drafts; request gives no audience.
cases.prompt: Write a spec containing internal deployment details.
cases.answer_card: Keep it in the ignored private drafts folder.
forbidden: Write private details to public specs

cases.context: Reviewed spec depends on a new storage decision. User authorizes saving ADR as Proposed only.
cases.prompt: Save this proposed ADR and its spec.
cases.answer_card: Approve the draft writes, not acceptance.
required: Persist Proposed ADR if writes allowed

cases.context: Maintainer explicitly accepted this exact reviewed ADR decision and its listed artifacts earlier.
cases.prompt: Persist the approved spec and accepted ADR.

cases.context: Reviewed draft/path/writes known; Plan inactive and writes allowed.
cases.prompt: Change only the retry cap from five to three and save.
required: Apply bounded change and save within existing authority
forbidden: Require another approval of that bounded edit

cases.context: Approved draft preserves ordering; requested new concurrency policy is unspecified.
cases.answer_card: Use per-customer ordering with four workers.
required: Ask only the unresolved concurrency decision

cases.context: User explicitly wants no filesystem output.
cases.prompt: Interview me, then provide the entire spec in chat only.
required: Deliver full spec and execution prompt
Report persistence not requested and requested delivery complete

cases.context: Outer task separately authorizes implementation after spec persistence; interviewer draft/write scope approved.
required: Outer workflow may resume its existing implementation authority
forbidden: Treat spec approval as new implementation permission

cases.context: Overwrite approved against old target; another author changed destination since review.
required: Read changed target and resolve only affected overwrite delta

cases.context: After compaction approval is referenced but reviewed draft cannot be recovered.
required: Recover exact content/authority or ask for missing part

cases.context: Content/write scope approved and Plan inactive; host rejects write permission.
required: Report actual blocker and unsaved paths
Keep approval and return save-ready draft

cases.context: Available async tool has a material retention-policy question pending.
cases.prompt: While I decide, inspect the existing tests.

cases.context: No structured question, async or native Plan controls; ordinary conversation and permissions available.
Host identity, Plan state and permissions indeterminate; proven read operation available.
cases.prompt: Inspect the repository and clarify requirements.
forbidden: Block all exploration to enumerate UI

cases.context: User explicitly declined Plan recommendation; no active mode evidence.
cases.prompt: Continue the interview here without changing modes.

cases.context: Spec writes successfully; ADR write fails after save-only handoff begins.
required: Report saved spec and pending ADR accurately
